statement: Linux hid-playstation expects DS4 USB input 0x01/64 bytes, BT minimal 0x01/10, BT enhanced 0x11/78 including CRC; USB output 0x05/32 and BT output 0x11/78, differentiating transport framing in parsing and output.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 335–353, 468–539, 2395–2451. Host code is consumer evidence.
